config.grain_rationale: One record is a single employment-services provider SITE (a physical service-delivery location) contracted under a DEWR program; the site's operator is a business participant, so SITE_NAME is mapped to entity.trading_name (a business/brand name, not a registered legal name). DIS_SITE_CODE identifies the site, not the business, so it is not used as a business identifier.

record_id.rationale: DIS_SITE_CODE is not unique per record (489 distinct across 505 discovery rows; repeated rows carry different CONTRACT_NAME/ESA_CD_1 values, and some codes are non-geographic placeholders such as EFTZ). No other candidate key is unique, so a content hash over the row is the only traceable identifier.

fields.rationale: SITE_NAME holds the provider's public brand/trading names (MAX Employment, Advanced Personnel Management, Job Centre Australia, CoAct/Community Solutions) as used on site listings. No evidence it is the registered legal name, so trading_name is the safe target.

SITE_URL holds the operator's website (www.apm.net.au, orsgroup.com.au, wiseemployment.com.au), present in 57.6% of rows. Holdout rows include phone numbers and 'TTY: 03 96143062' in this column, so a TLD-anchored regex_extract is applied: it keeps every genuine domain in discovery (all 88 distinct values are domain-shaped) while rejecting numeric/code values that would otherwise be emitted as websites.

Street address line of the service-delivery site; scope is the contracted premises, not a registered office. Values are truncated at about 45 chars in the source but remain usable address lines. Holdout contained a literal 'TBA' placeholder, now excluded via null_if.
Suburb/town of the site; matches LOCATION_NAME almost exactly (412 distinct each).
Two/three-letter AU state abbreviations only (NSW, VIC, QLD, SA, WA, TAS, ACT, NT; 8 distinct values, no overseas entries).
4-digit AU postcodes present 97% (492/505); 13 three-digit values are NT codes such as 822/850 which the postcode transform re-pads to 0822/0850.

constants.rationale: Australian Government (DEWR) employment services register; all records carry AU state codes and AU postcodes, with no NZ or other jurisdiction evidence.

unmapped.reason: Site identifier for a contracted service location, not a business identifier; also not unique per row and contains non-geographic placeholders (EFTZ).

DEWR programme/contract code (DESA, DESB, EPS5, TTW5, RJCP, NEI5, HLS5) naming the funding contract under which the site operates. It is not an ANZSIC industry code, so mapping to entity.industry_code would be wrong, and the ontology has no programme attribute; retained as unmapped rather than mis-typed.
Duplicates SITE_LOCALITY_NAME (412 distinct each); no added value over address.locality.
Site contact phone number; the ontology has no telephone target.
Site phone number, largely identical to SITE_CONTACT_PHONE; no telephone target in the ontology.
Freecall/13-number of the provider's call centre (27% present); contact detail, no telephone target.
Site mailbox, often a named individual (kal.perera@visionaustralia.org) or generic enquiries; a person/contact detail, not an entity field, and the ontology has no email target.
Employment Services Area geography code (e.g. 5ACT, 4SOE, 5MRV) denoting the service region of the site, not an ANZSIC industry code and not an entity identifier.
Employment Services Area code, blank in 100% of discovery rows.
Employment Services Area code, blank in 100% of discovery rows.
Site geocode with 'NULL' placeholders; no coordinate target in the ontology.
Site geocode with 'NULL' placeholders; no coordinate target in the ontology.
Trailing empty field created by a trailing comma in the header; contains no data in any row.

config.notes: Source is a site-level register: no ABN, ACN, legal entity name, entity type, status or registration date is present, so none of those is mapped. SITE_NAME is treated as trading_name only; the operator's registered legal name cannot be established from this file (some values such as 'OCTEC Limited' look legal but cannot be proven, so legal_name is not asserted). No date columns exist, so observation.observed_at falls back to resource last-modified and no validity dates are asserted. SITE_URL is guarded by a TLD-anchored regex because holdout rows carry phone numbers in that column; genuine domains are unchanged.
